notes.title: Update № 1.04
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37907212/d90730b6e09460d9d2127d24cdfe9e5e3f5cc0b3.png
“Hey, chronicler! Come and join us. We’re in for an interesting game. Everyone is going to participate and you’ll definitely enjoy it”.

The fall of the monarchy, the loss of beloved ones, the betrayal and the curse… The time before the tragedy, the bloodshed and the deaths. The time when Revinia was not at the verge of losing last hope. 
The renewal is the thing that stems from every cry of pain, but is it really worth suffering?

The story unfolds before the main course of events described in Untale: King of Revinia when the characters could afford a peaceful pastime. They used to hold carefree conversations, attend delicious feasts, have games.
Will you express the desire to witness that all with your very own eyes and enjoy them playing in a friendly manner? But mind, friendliness serves as a disguise for at least one of them who is engaged in intrigues and is already contemplating the King overthrown.

“I’m not your friend, you money rat.”

“Both of you are brats, who know nothing of life. Have you ever murdered anyone with your own hands?”

“Feast, Game and Murder” - a major update to Untale: King of Revinia that consists in the new game mode. Now you possess an opportunity to step into the shoes of Erlene Rollon, Bedivere Lessing, Norbert Kolas, Gerald Kolas or Carl Breton, if only for a while. Those were the people Walter Wile invited to join him.

Choose between one of the five characters, take on the role of the murderer and try to deceive Walter Wile.

Update № 1.04:

 The new game mode “Feast, Game and Murder” that tells about the feast, preceding the course of events described in Untale: King of Revinia. You can choose between five playable characters.

notes.title: hotfix 1.022
notes.notes:
We read through all your comments and launced a new patch. Thank you very much for making our game better, we appreciate your feedback!

All minor logical bugs are fixed
The root with [spoiler]Isabelle Lessing[/spoiler] is now easier to be achieved
[spoiler]To survive on the 5th night is now less difficult [/spoiler]

notes.title: Patch beta 0.2v
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37907212/8ee7877c53f13fbcab90324068773a8d3eb90f42.gif
Hi everyone!
Thank you for your feedback and all of your comments. We are trying to make our game better and appreciate all advice of yours. We have listened to you and made some improvements, fixed all bugs you found and much more.
About all the changes you can read in the list below.

 Adopted a new system of characters highlighting. Since now you will never confuse who is talking.
 Added a new image of the Royalboard which makes the game more atmospheric.
 Added new sound accompaniment.
 Added a special animated effect for thee scenes of day change.
 A secret ending is now dubbed.
